import { IconHome, IconFolder } from '@tabler/icons-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb'

export default function Particle() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink aria-label="Home" render={<Link href="/" />}>
            <IconHome aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator> · </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink render={<Link href="/docs/" />}>Components</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator> · </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Breadcrumb</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  )
}
